Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 2011
ACT V OF 2011
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the
Balochistan Local Government Act, 2010 (Act V of 2010)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 23rd May, 2011]
No.
PAB/Legis.V(06)/2011-1465, dated 23-5-2011.---The Balochistan Local Government
(Amendment) Bill No.6 of 2011, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Balochistan on 16th May, 2011 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on
19th May, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial
Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the
Balochistan Local Government Act, 2010 (Act No. V of 2010), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing.
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(l) This Act
may be called the Balochistan Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Amendment of section 16 of Act V of 2010

2. Amendment of
section 16 of Act, V of 2010.---In
the Balochistan Local Government Act, 2010 (Act No. V of 2010), in second
proviso of subsection (2) of section 16 for the words "within one year of
commencement of this Act" the words "during the year 2012" shall
be substituted.
